original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚112紧急号码在全国电视直播测试中未能接通
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚112紧急号码在Channels Television直播节目中接受测试，APC总统竞选委员会发言人Alwan Hassan要求主播Seun Okinbaloye现场拨打该号码。据报演播室多次拨打均未能接通，尽管Hassan坚称可以接通。该事件使112紧急号码服务受到审视。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚112紧急号码在电视直播测试中未能接通
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Nigeria’s 112 emergency number fails live test on national television

key_facts.fact: APC总统竞选委员会发言人Alwan Hassan要求主播现场拨打112测试
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Alwan Hassan, an APC Presidential Campaign Council spokesperson, challenged Channels Television anchor Seun Okinbaloye to test the service during a live broadcast

key_facts.fact: 据报演播室多次拨打该号码均失败
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: repeated attempts to call the number from the studio reportedly failed, despite Hassan’s insistence that it would connect

uncertainties: 拨打失败的具体原因尚未说明
